Shop Storefront Brief · Issue 8

Apple Search Ads is your paid routing layer. Assign the right Custom Product Page before you scale spend.

2026-08-28 · Fortune Insight, LLC · Operator intel for indie iOS teams. This page covers Apple Search Ads (ASA) → Custom Product Page (CPP) routing — ad variations, campaign and ad-group product-page choice, ad→landing creative congruence, geo and language constraints, and how paid routing differs from PPO and In-App Events — not a commission or IAP rate change. If you only track fee worksheets, Connect rules did not change because of this note.

What happened / why this follows Issues 5–7

Issue 5 showed how to build Custom Product Pages and localize screenshot sets in Connect. Issue 6 added the time-boxed In-App Event campaign layer. Issue 7 covered Product Page Optimization (PPO) as Connect's organic A/B test on the default page only.

This issue is the paid-traffic chapter: once a CPP exists and is App Review–approved, Apple Search Ads lets you create ad variations that pull creative from that CPP and send taps to the same page. The ad screenshot the buyer sees in search should match the CPP screenshot set they land on — not your generic default listing.

Operator framing: Issues 5–7 gave you storefront surfaces. Issue 8 wires which surface ASA clicks hit. If you shipped one CPP from Issue 5 and run ASA without an ad variation, you are still paying to send most taps to the default page.

Paid routing map — default vs CPP vs PPO vs In-App Event

Four Connect/ASA tools. ASA only controls the first tap — what happens after depends on which product page you assigned.

Surface What ASA can route to it Who sees it Paid-traffic rule
Default product page Yes — default ad when no ad variation is active Organic search, browse, and ASA taps with no CPP ad variation Keep for brand ad groups, Search Match discovery, and low-spend tests. PPO may be running experiments here — ASA traffic does not enter PPO splits.
Custom Product Page (CPP) Yes — via ASA ad variations linked to an approved CPP ASA taps on ad groups where you created a custom ad from that CPP; shareable ?ppid= URLs for non-ASA campaigns Primary paid landing. One CPP per keyword intent or audience theme — exact-match and high-spend ad groups first (Issue 5).
Product Page Optimization (PPO) No — Connect assigns organic traffic only Random sample of organic App Store visitors on the default page Do not expect PPO treatments on ASA-assigned CPP traffic. Run PPO after paid routing is stable (Issue 7).
In-App Event page No direct ASA assignment — event card sits on the product page the buyer already opened Product page visitors, search event cards, editorial surfaces during the event window Time-boxed layer on top of default or CPP. If an event is live, ASA taps still land on your assigned CPP or default — the event card appears on that page (Issue 6).

Rule of thumb: ASA ad variation = paid router. CPP = landing page. PPO = organic experiment on default only. In-App Event = timed campaign card layered on whichever page the visitor opened.

How ASA attaches to a CPP — campaigns, ad groups, ad variations

Apple Search Ads integrates with Connect-approved Custom Product Pages through ad variations (replacing the deprecated Creative Sets workflow for iOS 15.2+). When you create an ad variation, ASA uses the CPP's app preview videos and screenshots as the search ad creative, and the tap opens that same CPP — not the default listing.

  • Prerequisite: CPP must exist in App Store Connect, pass App Review, and show VALID state in ASA before you can select it. Deleted or unapproved CPPs do not appear in the ad-creation picker.
  • Where you assign: Apple Search Ads → Campaign → Ad Group → Ads dashboard → Create Ad → select the Custom Product Page. Each ad variation name is internal; the buyer sees CPP assets in the ad slot.
  • Ad group granularity: Assignment is per ad group, not per keyword. Structure campaigns so each ad group has one keyword theme — then one CPP ad variation per theme.
  • Default ad fallback: Ad groups without a custom ad variation serve the default product page creative. Search Match and broad discovery ad groups often stay on default until you have CPP data.
  • Deep links: CPPs can include deep links that open a specific in-app screen. Deep-link ad variations require devices on iOS/iPadOS 18+. Match the deep link to the keyword promise — e.g. "invoice scanner" keywords should not deep-link to settings.
  • Change anytime: You can reassign or pause ad variations without a new app binary. CPP asset edits in Connect require re-review and may pause the ad variation until assets are compatible with the ad group's countries and devices.

Operator catches: up to 70 ad variations per ad group in ASA, but most indie teams need one custom ad per ad group — not seventy. CPP analytics in Connect are separate from default-page metrics; compare ASA tap-through and CPP conversion in both dashboards.

When to route ASA to CPP vs default vs PPO

Scenario Route ASA to Why
Exact-match ad group on a high-intent keyword ("budget tracker", "habit journal") CPP with screenshot overlays matching that intent Ad creative and landing screenshots echo the search term — highest conversion lift per Apple's published case studies
Brand ad group (your app name) Default page or a brand CPP with core value prop Brand searchers often convert on default; a CPP is optional protection against competitor ads sending traffic to a generic page
Search Match or broad discovery Default page Keyword intent is unknown — a mismatched CPP hurts tap-through. Add CPP routing after you promote terms to exact-match ad groups
Active PPO test on default screenshots CPP on paid ad groups; leave PPO on organic default PPO never affects CPP-assigned ASA traffic — paid and organic experiments stay independent (Issue 7)
Live In-App Event promoting a limited-time offer CPP aligned with event copy, or default if event card carries the message Event card appears on whichever page ASA opens — do not assign a CPP whose screenshots contradict the event card (Issue 6)
zh-Hans or other localized storefront ASA campaign CPP with localized screenshot matrix for that locale ASA serves assets from the CPP locale matching the buyer's storefront — English overlays on a China campaign kill congruence (Issue 5)

Creative and asset constraints — ad→page match

ASA ad variations inherit CPP assets. You cannot upload separate ad-only screenshots — the search ad is the CPP preview. That makes creative congruence a Connect asset job, not an ASA upload job.

  • Same screenshots in ad and landing. Apple's ad-variation flow previews the CPP assets buyers will see after the tap. If overlay copy says "Track expenses" in the ad, frame 1 on the CPP must say the same — not a different feature.
  • Per-device asset completeness. CPP missing iPad screenshots falls back to iPhone assets or English default on iPad ASA impressions — check every device class your campaign targets.
  • 4+ ceiling applies. CPP screenshots used in ASA ad variations must meet the 4+ Creative Assets rating ceiling from Issue 4 — no unverifiable "#1" badges, price callouts, or competitor comparisons in ad frames.
  • App icon in ad preview. If your CPP or default page tests alternate app icons via PPO, the icon shown in the ASA preview may differ from the control — ASA pulls live CPP assets, not PPO treatments.
  • Country and device compatibility holds. An ad variation goes on hold if CPP assets are incompatible with the ad group's targeted countries, regions, or devices. Fix assets in Connect, then reactivate the ad in ASA.
  • Mainland China creative authorization. ASA ad variations targeting the App Store in mainland China may require creative authorization documentation. Rejected docs leave the ad on hold until approved.

Geo and language routing checklist

Step ASA / Connect action
1 · Match campaign storefront to CPP locale China ASA campaign → CPP with complete zh-Hans screenshot matrix. US campaign → en-US CPP or default with en-US assets. Do not route China spend to an English-only CPP.
2 · Verify CPP state in Connect Connect → your app → Custom Product Pages → confirm status is approved and not disabled. ASA will not list deleted or pending CPPs.
3 · Create ad variation in ASA Ad Group → Ads → Create Ad → name internally (e.g. asa-budget-cpp1) → select CPP → preview on iPhone and iPad → Save.
4 · Test the ?ppid= URL on device Open the CPP link in the target storefront locale before scaling bids. Confirm subtitle, promotional text, and screenshots match the ad preview.
5 · Leave Search Match on default Discovery traffic with unknown intent stays on default until you promote winning keywords to exact-match ad groups with dedicated CPPs.
6 · Monitor ASA and Connect separately ASA: impressions, taps, CPT, conversion. Connect → Analytics → filter by CPP name for product-page impressions and downloads attributed to that page.
7 · Pause before conflicting surface changes Do not swap CPP screenshots mid-flight while an In-App Event or PPO test promotes conflicting copy on the same intent — pause the ad variation, finish the other surface, then reactivate.

Operator catches: duplicating an ad group or campaign to a new country does not automatically carry compatible ad variations — localized CPP assets may be required for the destination storefront. ASA API exposes CPP creatives as type CUSTOM_PRODUCT_PAGE with a productPageId if you automate later; most indie teams should wire manually first.

What this is not

  • Not a new US or EU commission rate. EU unified terms still land 2026-10-01 — see Issue 0.
  • Not a CPP build guide — screenshot localization and Connect setup are in Issue 5.
  • Not an In-App Event or PPO workflow — those are separate layers in Issue 6 and Issue 7.
  • Not a guarantee of lower CPI or higher ROAS. Better ad→page match helps; keyword relevance, bid strategy, and product-market fit still dominate.
  • Not Meta or Google UAC routing — ASA only serves App Store search (and select Apple surfaces). Off-store landing pages are out of scope.
  • If you do not run Apple Search Ads and have no paid acquisition plan this quarter: no ASA routing work needed — skip to organic PPO or metadata from Issue 7 instead.

What an indie can do this week

  • Confirm your Issue 5 CPP is approved in Connect. If not, finish App Review before creating ASA ad variations.
  • Open Apple Search Ads → highest-spend exact-match ad group → Ads → Create Ad → select that CPP. Preview on iPhone and iPad; verify overlay copy matches the keyword theme.
  • Leave Search Match on the default page until you have at least two weeks of CPP vs default conversion data in Connect analytics.
  • If you run ASA toward China or another localized storefront: confirm the CPP zh-Hans (or target locale) screenshot matrix is complete for every device class — not just iPhone 6.7".
  • Do not start a PPO screenshot test and swap CPP assets on the same keyword intent in the same window — pick one experiment layer (Issue 7).
  • Do not reprice IAP or rebuild checkout because of ASA routing — this is a paid landing-page workflow, not a commission update.
